input: Requests of the story of the active project (segments, M markers, covers, selection, undo/redo), through the one intermediary of the project database (qnc-db-broker), which hands this table module its connection.
output: The story tables of the project database (story_state, story_parts, story_markers, story_marker_slots, story_covers, story_object_history, story_undo) and their public views. It creates only its own tables, writes no other table (authorizer), reads only public views of others (public_project_settings; the clip catalog through qnc-content-read, so only an imported clip goes into a story). A cover names the B-roll virtual shot its owner made first (v5 create_cover after add_virtual_shot_from_frames). Every story edit is an undo step. Moved unchanged from qnc-content-store (lego split B3, user rule 2026-09-26).
